actual_scope: Independently certify the unique rank-three block completions and the sharp minimum raw pairing cost twelve of PR2111/2162's pinned anti-Fano configuration, using binary row/column subspace enumeration instead of SAT or jets.
scope_change_reason: The drawn H2/K question is already covered by PR1194/1782/1805 and related work. A possible selected-bit profile recount was also already covered by PR1421. Take the explicit unreserved independent-check request in Discussion1166 comment18934590, item1, without another task draw. This is a side result relative to the helper-contract card, not a replacement interface.
bottleneck_link: A source-bound independent audit of an existing three-total decoder floor checks one proposed low-rank route on the binding complex side. It changes no supplier, paid profile or selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop after this one twelve-line configuration. A census disagreement falsifies the proposed corroboration and must be reported rather than weakening uniqueness. Do not enumerate all 2^72 matrices or claim the general T=3 conjecture.
evidence: EXPECTED.json; verify.py reconstructs all three unique completions in two orientations and validates an admissible (4,4,4) witness. test_verify.py supplies dense rank, multiple-completion, impossible-completion and corruption controls. README gives completeness and the credited projection/exchange proof.
